x: Simon who has been training under John Sullivan's guidance has been running for less than a year. 14 year old Richard Addison won the Boys Club 800m Championships in 2.18.6 with newcomer Jim Biesty second.
Special mention for: Jim Biesty a new member who turned in one of the fastest colts times of the day. Andrew North who looked really sharp in moving the boys team from 8th to 3rd.
James Biesty, already a specialist trackman over 1500 metres, but finding Cross Country requiring a different technique, persevered to produce a number of creditable and consistent results.

Although dogged by injury James Biesty won the club championship behind 2nd claim John Booth. Simon Beaumont, after a long illness, returned to racing late in the season to achieve a creditable 8th in the Herne Hill league.
